# Atrix Explorer

> A mobile web browser optimized for manga, manhwa, and novel readers.

Atrix Explorer is an Android application designed specifically to enhance the experience of reading and tracking web comics and novels. It acts as a universal tracker.

## Key Features
- **Universal Tracking**: Keep track of your reading progress across various manhwa, manga, manhua, and webtoon sites.
- **Reader-Focused Browser**: Includes tools and optimizations to make reading long-strip comics and novels smoother on mobile devices.
- **Library Organization**: Manage, organize, and discover new titles all from within the app.
